recipe.title: Six onigiri maison
recipe.instructions:
Cook 1 cup of dry sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Bake the salmon at 200°C (400°F) for approximately 25 minutes, or until fully cooked.
Flake the cooked salmon with a fork and mix with the yogurt until combined.
Slice or mash the avocado.
Cut the nori sheets in half.
Line a round pan with plastic wrap.
Spread approximately half of the cooked rice evenly over the bottom of the pan.
Add an even layer of the salmon mixture.
Add a layer of sliced or mashed avocado.
Spread the remaining rice evenly on top.
Cover with another layer of plastic wrap and gently press down to compact the layers. Place a plate over the pan, hold it firmly, and carefully flip the pan upside down. Remove the pan and plastic wrap.
Cut into 6 triangles, as shown in the video.
Wrap each triangle with a piece of nori.
